arm_a_baseline_trial.strict_acceptance: FAILED: 4/4 measured mains 400; measurement_valid true; raw records retained
arm_a_baseline_trial.mechanism: every main query natively reads the whole documents + whole doc_groups tables (boundary CTEs resolve the 20 readable groups by full-scan; doc_groups is ordered (doc_id, group_id) so group->docs is not a prefix seek); ~30M rows across the four service CTEs per main

arm_d_rekey.single_pass: create -> INSERT SELECT re-sort (3.1M rows, 2.5 s) -> row/content/per-author/25-spot parity (all equal) -> sequential live feeds pre-flip -> atomic RENAME flip (0.2 s, old table kept as documents_old_arma) -> sequential live feeds post-flip: exact main-output parity (identical row hashes both readers)
arm_d_rekey.scope: PLAN §8 production-migration mechanics dry-run on the frozen input; rollback path retained

arm_d_treatment.declared: PROTOCOL §4: 'the query must be written to exploit the key (author set + time predicate pushed into the scan)'
arm_d_treatment.mechanism: each of the four boundary CTEs rewritten from documents-full-scan + doc_groups-full-scan to documents WHERE collection_name='<svc>' AND author_key IN (20 verified owners) — 20 prefix seeks on the D key; the group-keyed gates dropped (verified empty per request); dg.group_id synthesized as a CASE over the verified author->owner mapping; I3 retained via per-request point verification (20 memberships, 20 owner pairs, 5 gate tables empty); the compiled SQL must byte-match the pinned golden structure (evidence/arm-d-compiled-main-golden-20261109.sql, parameterised) or the treatment refuses
arm_d_treatment.research_only: gated by COSTFN_ARM_D=1 in research_api (research entry point only; production app.main never sees the flag); offline regression arm_d_rewrite.test.py (7 tests) pins the transform + refusals
arm_d_treatment.output_parity: exact 20 IDs/order on every probe and trial main (oracle check_result)

arm_d_trial.strict_acceptance: FAILED: mains 4/4 200 (the treatment held under concurrency), engagement follow-ups + node-ad inventory still in Arm A shape drove 2x code-159 then a 137 (CH OOM-killed at the pinned 5 GB cap); lifecycle post-500s downstream of the CH death; measurement_valid true; raw records retained (.context/k20-1m-disp3-armD-trial/)

result_statement: At K=20/N=1M on the frozen input, the personal main feed query went from Arm A (3.7M-7.2M native rows, 215-885 MB, 1.4-3.9 s cold single-threaded; concurrent sequence fails the pinned allocation) to Arm D treated (74k rows / 2.6 MB / ~36 ms native execute, ~260 ms end-to-end including point verification): ~50x fewer bytes per main query, exact output parity, I3-verified. The pre-declared main-query target (p95 < 500 ms AND bytes < 25 MB) is MET by the treated main query. The full feed SEQUENCE does not yet meet it: the two engagement follow-ups (~3.7M rows / ~215 MB each) and the node-ad inventory read (7.2M rows / 843 MB) are still Arm A shape.
next_bounded_iteration: declared, evidence-backed, same family as merged Q01 (#1448 exact-ID pruning): (1) engagement follow-ups are exact-ID queries — resolve their readability by doc_id IN (20) against doc_groups (doc_id is its key prefix: 20 seeks) instead of the group-scan, leaving the service-table read (reactions ~310k / comments ~31k) as the residual; (2) the node-ad inventory read is a fixture constant (zero node ads in the input) — either a bounded treatment (empty-inventory short-circuit verified against node_config) or a declared exclusion from the feed-sequence cost metric; either way named before the run. No new optimizer idea beyond these.
scope: Phase-0 local evidence on the frozen input, pinned allocation, research stack. Not Phase-1 study discipline (no multi-trial yet), not a capacity claim, not production. The 4 extra documents on this stack are the Arm A trial's lifecycle-control writes (steady-refresh condition), present on both key states.

followup_exact_id.mechanism: the compiled follow-up's one boundary CTE (documents service window + doc_groups window over 21 groups) is rewritten: documents window gains ref_value IN (returned post ids) [declared residual: the whole service partition, ~3.1M native rows on the D key, filtered to ~310k reactions / ~31k comments, result 20]; the doc_groups join and group-keyed gates are dropped; readability verified per request by point-scale checks (20 returned posts readable via the requested groups by doc_id seek on doc_groups — its key prefix — + reader Discover membership + empty gate tables); author-keyed gates retained
followup_exact_id.pinned: byte-exact golden pin per service (evidence/arm-d-compiled-followup-{reactions,comments}-golden-20261110.sql); non-follow-up shapes (prepare-pass canonical reads) return None, not an error; drift refuses
followup_exact_id.native_read: ~3.19M rows / 126 MB per treated follow-up (vs ~3.7M / 215 MB Arm A shape)

ad_inventory_ttl.mechanism: verified TTL short-circuit (chosen over the exclusion alternative; declared in PROTOCOL before the run): one live, verified read per 60 s window served to all sessions (the shared-surface cache principle); this input has zero node ads — the live read returns [] and is counted; live_reads/cache_hits recorded per request in the observer
ad_inventory_ttl.native_read: 7.2M rows / 843 MB per LIVE read only (<=1 per 60 s window instead of per feed)
